title: ClearPath Managed IT Services Automatic Renewal Into the Next Term
content:
At the end of its term, a ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement whose automatic renewal is on rolls into its renewal term. This desk note covers recording that automatic renewal and the per-seat rate it carries.

## Scope of the renewal pricing

For an automatic renewal, meaning an agreement whose automatic renewal is on rolling into its renewal term at term end, and only for such a renewal, the renewal per-seat rate is set by the renewal pricing schedule. A renewal under a signed renewal on an agreement whose automatic renewal is off remains under the base rule: its per-seat rate is the expiring per-seat rate increased by the tier's renewal uplift cap percent, rounded half up to the cent, unless the tier's current list fee per seat reduced by its term discount for the renewal term length is lower, in which case the lower rate applies.

## What the renewal records

The renewal is recorded at term end, with:
- the term start date the day after the expiring term end date;
- the term length equal to the tier's renewal term in months;
- the contracted seats equal to the agreement's seat count on the expiring term end date, but never less than the tier's minimum seats;
- the renewal count increased by one;
- the renewal per-seat rate.

## Invocation: `record_renewal_term_69c0d348`

**Capability.** Records the automatic renewal of a ClearPath agreement into its next term. The agreement's current term start and end dates, term length, per-seat rate and seat commitment are replaced by those of the renewal term, and its renewal count goes up by one. Status, seats covered, notices and balance are left as they are. On success the agreement shows the renewal term in force.

**How it is invoked.** `record_renewal_term_69c0d348` is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `managed_agreement_id` | the reference number of the ClearPath agreement being renewed, as returned by the agreement lookup for the verified client | identifier |
| `seat_rate_usd` | the per-seat monthly rate for the renewal term in US dollars | decimal number with 2 decimal places (cents); stored rounded to the cent |
| `contracted_seats` | the seat commitment for the renewal term | integer seats, a whole number |
| `term_start_date` | the first day of the renewal term | calendar date YYYY-MM-DD (US Eastern business date) |
| `term_end_date` | the last day of the renewal term | calendar date YYYY-MM-DD (US Eastern business date) |
| `term_months` | the length of the renewal term | integer number of months |

**Return.** A confirmation string naming the agreement reference, the renewal term dates (YYYY-MM-DD), the term length in months, the renewal per-seat rate in US dollars with 2 decimals, the seat commitment and the new renewal count; it begins with "Renewal recorded" when the renewal term is in force on the agreement.
